title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About the role**

As a
**Forward Deployed Engineer at**
SquadStack.ai, you’ll work on building and evolving production-grade Voice AI systems that customers actively use.

You’ll operate close to real deployments - identifying gaps surfaced by live usage, designing solutions, and shipping them into production. Some work moves fast; some work is planned and iterative. What matters is that priorities are driven by real customer outcomes, not by work defined quarters in advance.

You’ll leverage the SquadStack platform to configure, extend, and build AI-native workflows, while writing production-quality code where needed. You’ll work in a small pod alongside Customer Success and AI PM partners, owning technical execution end-to-end.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer reality -
**with a strong emphasis on code quality, system reliability, and long-term leverage over one-off fixes.**

***Apply even if you’re only 70% sure. The conversation itself is valuable.***

**What you'll do**

You’ll work in a
**small pod**
(CSM / AI PM handles customer communication; you handle technical execution), solving problems that block customer success but aren’t yet on the product roadmap
**.**

**Your engineering work includes:**

* Building custom integrations, tools, and AI workflows that unblock customer needs
* Designing and refining AI prompts, RAG systems, and LLM-based solutions
* Writing production-quality code (Python / JavaScript) with the same standards as core engineering
* Deciding whether solutions should remain custom, become reusable, or move into the core product
* Collaborating with core engineering teams to upstream learnings and reduce future friction.

**What you will
*not*
do:**

* Run customer calls
* Own accounts
* Chase stakeholders
* Do repetitive support work

**This is NOT solutions engineering**

You do not deliver one-off scripts and move on

Every solution is evaluated on leverage:

* Can this be reused?
* Can this become a product primitive?
* Can this eliminate future manual work?

Custom work is acceptable only if the business makes sense, or it is experimental, where we’d learn something new.

Strong solutions frequently get upstreamed into:

* Core platform capabilities
* Reusable internal tooling
* Product roadmap items owned by core engineering

**Your success is measured by reduced future friction - not by how many customers you personally unblock.**

**Code quality:**
Same high bar

**Technical difficulty:**
Often harder - real-world problems are messier and more near-term in nature than planned roadmaps

**Two engineering tracks - both valuable:**

**Core Engineering:**

* Product Roadmap
* Roadmap and sprint-driven
* Deep, well-scoped, long-lived
* Platform & system optimisation
* Slower, abstracted
* Platform Abstractions & scalability

**Customer Impact (This Role):**

* Day-to-day customer usage & success signals
* Signal-driven; flexible planning
* Broad, evolving, discovery-heavy
* Unblocking + generalising into scale
* Immediate, real-world
* Reduction of future friction & repeat issues

**Both are real engineering. Both lead to staff or lead roles. Both are equally respected.**

**Why ambitious engineers choose this role**

**🚀Unmatched learning velocity:**

* Build with cutting-edge AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG) in production
* Learn what actually makes products succeed in real markets
* Develop full-stack skills alongside business judgment

**⚡Real Autonomy:**

* Choose your own tools and approaches
* Ship when ready - not when a sprint ends
* Direct influence on the product roadmap & org metrics via real usage

**💪Career acceleration:**

Engineers from this track commonly become:

* Product Engineers who can both build and prioritise
* Technical Leads who deeply understand customer reality
* Founding Engineers or CTOs at startups with a complete skill stack

**🎯Immediate impact:**

* Direct feedback from real usage
* Clear line from your work to business outcomes

**What we’re looking for**

**Technical baseline:**

* Strong programming fundamentals (Python / JavaScript preferred,
  **but talent > language)**
* Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete requirements
* Curiosity about AI / ML in production (expertise is a bonus, not a requirement)

**Mindset fit:**

* **Ownership:**
  Takes end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks; drives problems to resolution even across unclear boundaries.
* **Pragmatic:**
  Focused on solutions that work now
* **Curious:**
  Wants to understand the “why” behind problems
* **Entrepreneurial:**
  Treats technical problems as business problems
* **Communicative:**
  Can translate technical decisions into a business context
* **AI Native:**
  Exposure to AI systems or prompt & context engineering.

**Should I apply?**

**YES, if you:**

* Want to work on AI-native products at the frontier
* Enjoy variety - no two weeks look the same
* Care about understanding the “why” behind what you build
* Prefer building solutions over strictly following specs
* I am curious about how engineering decisions affect business outcomes

**MAYBE NOT, if you:**

* Prefer predictable, tightly defined work
* Dislike exposure to business or customer context
* Need detailed specs to be productive
* Prefer large teams over small, autonomous pods
* Want to avoid ambiguity or rapid context-switching

**Day-to-day reality**

No two weeks look the same, but a typical flow might look like this:

* **Monday:**
  Pod sync to review customer progress and technical blockers. One issue stands out - a workflow the product doesn’t fully support yet.
* **Tuesday:**
  Prototype a solution (integration, tool, or AI workflow). Loop in core engineering early if it looks reusable.
* **Wednesday:**
  Refine the solution - edge cases, AI prompt behaviour, reliability. Decide whether this should remain custom or be generalised.
* **Thursday:**
  Ship to production. Monitor real usage. Iterate quickly if needed.
* **Friday:**
  Share learnings, move on to the next.

**Quick Check?**

* **Freedom level:**
  High
* **Bureaucracy:**
  Low
* **Learning curve:**
  Steep
* **Impact visibility:**
  Immediate and measurable

**Logistics**

* **Location:**
  Noida
* **Compensation:**
  Competitive!
* **Joining:**
  ASAP!

**Why should you consider us seriously?**

* We believe that long-term, people over product and profits, prioritize culture over everything else.
* We are a well-balanced team of experienced entrepreneurs and are backed by top investors across India and Silicon Valley (Chiratae Ventures, Blume Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Emergent Ventures; Senior execs at Google, Square, Genpact & Flipkart; Co-founders of Infosys, Snapdeal, Slideshare, Zomato, etc.)
* Freedom and Responsibility 🦅
* Entrepreneurial Team 💪
* Exponential Growth 📈
* Healthcare (Physical & Mental Wellness) 😌

***Please Note:***

***SquadStack is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. SquadStack is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.***

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Clearwater Analytics**
Clearwater Analytics is a global SaaS leader in automated investment data aggregation, reconciliation, accounting, and reporting. Serving the world's largest asset managers, insurance companies, and corporations, Clearwater processes trillions of dollars in assets daily. Our Beacon Risk & Pricing Platform delivers real-time risk analytics and pricing intelligence — powered by reliable, high-quality market data and reference data pipelines at the core.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Beacon Risk & Pricing Platform team. In this role you will design, build, and operate mission-critical market data and reference data pipelines that feed our real-time pricing and risk engines. You will work closely with quant researchers, data vendors, and platform engineers to ensure that high-quality, low-latency data flows reliably across the entire investment analytics stack.
  
  
This is a high-impact, high-ownership role. You will make architectural decisions, mentor peers, and directly influence how Clearwater ingests, normalises, and distributes market data at scale.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Market & Reference Data Pipelines
  
  

* Design and build scalable Python-based ETL/ELT pipelines ingesting multi-asset market data (equities, fixed income, derivatives, FX, commodities) from vendors such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv/LSEG, ICE Data Services, and FactSet.
* Engineer and maintain a robust securities master (reference data) system covering identifiers (CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, FIGI), corporate actions, instrument attributes, and classification hierarchies.
* Build real-time and batch data feeds using AWS-native services (Kinesis, MSK/Kafka, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions) with SLAs measured in milliseconds to seconds.
* Implement data quality frameworks — completeness checks, anomaly detection, stale-data alerting, and automated reconciliation against authoritative vendor sources.

Platform & Infrastructure
  
  

* Architect cloud-native, event-driven data infrastructure on AWS (S3, Redshift, RDS Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache) with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / CDK).
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and ensure deployments are automated, tested, and observable (CloudWatch, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).
* Drive schema design, data modelling, and partitioning strategies that balance query performance against storage cost at petabyte scale.

**Required**
**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years building production data pipelines in Python (Pandas, PySpark, asyncio, or equivalent).
* Deep hands-on experience with AWS data services: S3, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis / MSK, Redshift, RDS, Step Functions.
* Strong understanding of market data domains — pricing, corporate actions, identifier mapping, instrument reference data — from a financial services or fintech context.
* Experience designing and operating high-availability, low-latency streaming and batch pipelines in production.
* Proficiency in SQL and data modelling for analytical and operational workloads.
* Familiarity with data quality patterns: schema validation, reconciliation, SLA monitoring, dead-letter queues, and alerting.
* Strong communication skills — you write clear design docs, run productive tech discussions, and collaborate across disciplines.

**Preferred**

* Experience with securities master / reference data systems: CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, FIGI, and corporate action processing.
* Prior integration with major market data vendors (Bloomberg B-PIPE / SAPI, Refinitiv/LSEG Elektron, ICE Data Services).
* Knowledge of Apache Airflow or similar workflow orchestration tools.
* Experience with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or other open table formats for data lake management.
* Familiarity with risk or pricing platforms in asset management or insurance investment operations.
* AWS Professional or Specialty certifications (Data Analytics, Solutions Architect).

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
**About eBasics Global**

eBasics Global Pvt. Ltd. is a technology-driven software company building innovative digital products

powered by Artificial Intelligence, cloud technologies, and modern engineering.

One of our flagship products, Narzim Healthcare, is an AI-powered healthcare platform designed to

simplify clinical workflows, patient documentation, healthcare operations, and medical record

management. Leveraging Generative AI, AI Agents, and intelligent automation, we are building solutions that empower healthcare professionals to deliver better patient care while reducing administrative burden.

**Role Overview**

The candidate will be responsible for building AI agents, LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and healthcare workflow automation. The ideal candidate should have practical experience taking AI solutions from concept to production. They should be comfortable working with large language models, Python-based backend services, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure. This role requires an engineer who can independently implement AI features and collaborate with backend, frontend, and product teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Agents & Agentic Workflows**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI Agents for healthcare and administrative workflows.
* Build autonomous workflows capable of retrieving information, using tools, executing multi-step tasks, and interacting securely with application APIs.
* Implement agent orchestration, structured outputs, memory, state management, tool calling, and human approval workflows.
* Develop reusable AI Agent components that support multiple healthcare use cases.
* Implement error handling, retries, permission controls, execution limits, and audit trails.

**Generative AI & LLM Integration**

* Integrate and optimize Large Language Models such as OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent platforms.
* Develop prompt pipelines, structured outputs, context management, and model routing strategies.
* Optimize AI applications for accuracy, latency, scalability, and operational cost.
* Build reusable AI services and evaluation frameworks to ensure consistent model performance.

**AI Medical Scribe & Clinical Documentation**

* Develop AI-powered medical scribing solutions that convert doctor-patient conversations into structured clinical documentation.
* Integrate speech-to-text, transcription, and speaker diarisation technologies.
* Generate draft SOAP notes, patient summaries, and structured clinical records for physician review.
* Extract symptoms, medications, allergies, diagnoses, medical history, assessments, and follow-up recommendations.
* Continuously improve documentation quality, completeness, and transcription accuracy.

**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**

* Design and implement RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and metadata filtering.
* Build intelligent search capabilities for patient records and healthcare knowledge.
* Develop context-aware patient summaries and source-grounded AI responses.
* Continuously evaluate retrieval quality and reduce hallucinations.

**Patient Intelligence & Healthcare Automation**

* Build AI-powered Patient 360 summaries using authorized patient information.
* Develop AI assistants that prepare referrals, patient instructions, draft documentation, and clinical notes.
* Automate repetitive healthcare workflows using intelligent AI Agents.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing clinical and patient management workflows while ensuring appropriate human oversight.

**Backend Development & System Integration**

* Build scalable AI backend services using Python and FastAPI.
* Develop secure REST APIs and integrate AI services with existing healthcare applications.
* Work with PostgreSQL, asynchronous processing, background workers, and event-driven architectures.
* Design reusable and scalable backend services following modern software engineering practices.

**AI Evaluation, Monitoring & Optimization**

* Develop automated evaluation pipelines for AI Agents, RAG systems, and generated clinical
* documentation.
* Monitor response quality, latency, failures, token consumption, and infrastructure costs.
* Implement observability using tools such as Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent platforms.
* Continuously improve AI quality using production metrics, testing, and user feedback.

**Security & Healthcare Data Privacy**

* Develop AI systems following secure software engineering practices.
* Implement secure API integrations, tenant isolation, audit logging, and least-privilege access.
* Protect AI systems against prompt injection, unsafe tool execution, and sensitive data exposure.
* Support HIPAA-aligned engineering practices and healthcare data privacy requirements.

**Required Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience building backend applications using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent LLM platforms.
* Experience building AI Agents using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks.
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Experience with SQL, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and backend integrations.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and AWS or similar cloud platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, model evaluation, and AI optimization.
* Experience building and deploying production-grade AI applications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on Healthcare AI, Medical NLP, Clinical Documentation, or Medical Scribing solutions.
* Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems and healthcare workflows.
* Knowledge of FHIR, HL7, or SMART on FHIR.
* Experience with speech-to-text, transcription, or speaker diarisation technologies.
* Familiarity with vector search technologies such as vector, OpenSearch, Pinecone, or Weaviate.
* Exposure to Next.js or TypeScript is an added advantage.

**Candidates with exceptional AI engineering expertise and strong production experience are encouraged to apply even without prior healthcare domain experience.**

**Why Join eBasics Global?**

* Build cutting-edge AI solutions with real-world healthcare impact.
* Work on AI Agents, Generative AI, RAG, and enterprise-scale LLM applications.
* Be part of the team developing Narzim Healthcare, an AI-first healthcare platform.
* Collaborate with experienced engineers in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.
* Enjoy opportunities for continuous learning, ownership, and professional growth.

title: AI Architect
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and consultative
**AI Architect**
to help clients understand, shape, and activate the potential of AI in their business. This role owns the architecture of the AI solutions we propose — across pursuits, not just within one — and is accountable for the technical credibility of what we commit to.
  
  
You will partner with sales, industry specialists, engineering, and client executives to turn priority AI use cases into architectures that are demonstrable in weeks and defensible at enterprise scale: secure, cost-aware, evaluable, and buildable by the delivery teams that inherit them.
  
  
It is deliberately a
**hands-on architect**
role. You will still open the IDE, still build the hard part of the prototype, and still debug an agent that reasons badly — while setting the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that everyone else builds on.
  
  
AI/Gen AI/Gen AI
  
  
Shape demand and executive conviction
  
  

* Lead discovery and architecture workshops with client business and technology leadership; set the agenda rather than respond to it.
* Identify pain points, value levers, and high-impact AI opportunities, and sequence them into a pragmatic AI roadmap (quick wins → platform investments).
* Translate ambiguous, complex client questions into solution hypotheses, target-state architecture, and a phased path to get there.
* Build AI scenarios and value frameworks that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes and a defensible business case.

Own the architecture
  
  

* Own end-to-end architecture: LLM and model-portfolio selection, context engineering, retrieval and knowledge architecture, agent orchestration, microservices, integrations, data platform touchpoints, and UI.
* Set the non-functional bar and design to it — latency, throughput, unit cost per interaction, accuracy/eval thresholds, observability, safety, security, data residency, and auditability.
* Define reference architectures, agentic blueprints, and accelerator standards for the practice; govern their reuse so pursuits start at 40% rather than zero.
* Make and document build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including model routing, fine-tuning vs prompting vs retrieval, and open vs proprietary model strategy.

Prove it
  
  

* Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints — personally on the critical path, and through the FDE pod for the rest.
* Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning, safety, and performance; establish the evaluation and red-teaming approach that lets us state quality claims with evidence.
* Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, arbitrating scope so the proof lands inside the sales cycle.

Win and hand over
  
  

* Author and quality-gate client-ready content: architecture decks, SoWs, proposals, estimates, value frameworks, risk and assumption registers, and demo storylines.
* Lead technical deep-dives, security and architecture reviews, and competitive differentiation discussions; handle the hardest objections in the room.
* Refine solution narratives based on client feedback and market conditions.
* Oversee a seamless transition from sales to delivery — architecture decision records, working code, known risks, and continuity of the people involved.

Build the practice
  
  

* Create thought leadership and reusable IP; represent the firm externally at client forums, partner events, and in published material.
* Mentor AI Leads and engineering teams; grow the bench of people who can do this role.
* Collaborate with hyperscalers and product partners to craft next-generation AI-led experiences and co-funded initiatives.

**Must-have Skills And Experience**
**Architecture and platform depth**

* Proven track record architecting and shipping production-grade GenAI/agentic systems in enterprise environments — not only pilots.
* Deep command of LLM selection and evaluation, context engineering, model routing and cost control, and the trade-offs between prompting, retrieval, tool use, and fine-tuning.
* Strong microservices and integration architecture: event-driven and API-led patterns, identity and access, secrets, multi-tenancy, and integration with core enterprise systems.
* Enterprise concerns as first-class design inputs: security, privacy, data residency, model governance, responsible AI, and regulatory constraints.

**Agentic AI engineering (hands-on)**

* Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
* Design and debugging of multi-agent and long-horizon workflows, including failure modes, recovery, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* Strong experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tokenization, and prompt engineering — including retrieval evaluation and knowledge-freshness strategy.

**Engineering craft (hands-on)**

* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
* Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.
* Hands-on Docker-based deployment, CI/CD, and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control and review — mandatory.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).

**Model Provider And Hyperscaler GenAI Platform Know-how**
  
  

* Broad, current understanding of the GenAI offerings across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscalers, with deep, hands-on mastery of at least one — deep enough to design on it, defend it in a client architecture review, and know where it breaks:

+ Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use and extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an integration standard, Claude delivered via Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI, and enterprise deployment and governance patterns.
+ OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning, batch and realtime APIs, enterprise data-handling commitments.
+ AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and integration with AWS data, identity and security services.
+ Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling, evaluation), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
+ Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native identity, networking and compliance patterns.

* Able to construct and defend a multi-provider model strategy: capability-to-task mapping, model routing and tiering, benchmark and eval evidence, context-window and latency envelopes, unit economics, rate limits and capacity planning, deprecation and version-migration risk.
* Fluent in the enterprise decision criteria that actually settle these choices — data residency and sovereignty, tenant isolation, IP and training-data commitments, certifications and auditability, regional availability, and the client's existing cloud and licensing commitments.
* Designs for portability where it matters: provider-abstracted interfaces, gateway/routing layers, and prompt and eval assets that survive a model or vendor change, without over-abstracting to the point of losing provider-specific capability.
* Keeps pace with a fast-moving field and translates new releases into concrete client opportunity, filtering hype from what is production-ready.

**Consultative and commercial ability**

* Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and articulation skills; credible with a CIO/CDO and with a client's principal engineer in the same day.
* Commercial fluency: estimation, deal shaping, pricing implications of architecture choices, and the discipline to say no to a use case that will not survive contact with production.
* Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, or LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

Good to have
  
  

* Prior experience in a pre-sales, consulting, solution-architecture, or forward-deployed engineering capacity at scale.
* Recognised depth in one or more industry domains (BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail/CPG, manufacturing, telecom, energy).
* Experience running partner-funded or co-innovation programmes with a hyperscaler or model provider (AWS, Microsoft, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA or ISV partners), including funding programmes, early-access participation, and joint go-to-market.
* Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML or architect track, or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.
* Experience with self-hosted / open-weight model deployment (vLLM, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints, on-prem GPU) for clients with strict data-boundary requirements.
* Published thought leadership, patents, open-source contributions, or conference speaking on GenAI/agentic systems.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

7–10 years overall, with at least 3 years of relevant AI / GenAI experience
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to design, build and deploy AI agents and Generative AI solutions for enterprise applications. The candidate will build agents that plan tasks, call tools and APIs, and complete multi-step workflows, along with the prompts, retrieval (RAG) pipelines and integrations behind them. The role also requires daily use of AI coding assistants to speed up delivery.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be able to work with data scientists, software engineers, product owners and business stakeholders to take AI solutions from idea to production.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and deploy AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI or AutoGen.

* Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar) for development, testing, code reviews and documentation.

* Lead AI projects end to end, ensuring timely delivery and quality.
* Mentor junior engineers, review code and share best practices with the team.
* Present AI opportunities and project updates to senior management and stakeholders.
* Support RFPs, RFIs, solution demos and proofs of concept.

* 7+ years of overall experience in software engineering, data engineering or ML engineering.

* Strong prompt engineering skills for real business use cases.

* Experience integrating AI with applications through REST APIs, SDKs and tool / function calling.
* Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor.
* Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) and its AI services.
* Experience with Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Good problem-solving, analytical and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Front-end skills to build simple agent interfaces (React, Streamlit, Gradio or similar).
* Experience in client-facing delivery, pre-sales or proofs of concept.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols.
* Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas or DeepEval.
* Exposure to classic ML using TensorFlow, PyTorch or scikit-learn, and data processing with pandas, NumPy or Spark.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work in cross-functional teams.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to adapt quickly to fast-changing AI technologies and business requirements.

title: AI Technology Consultant
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Staff / Senior Staff – AI-Enabled Technology Advisory**
**India**
**Role Overview**
Crowe’s Technology Advisory practice is seeking a hands-on AI-enabled technology advisory professional to join our India-based team and support U.S.-based consulting teams.
  
  
This role is designed for someone who actively works in AI tools throughout the day and enjoys building, testing, refining, and documenting better ways of working. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills with practical AI fluency to support client engagements and build reusable workflows for research, file analysis, synthesis, writing, presentation development, and knowledge management.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Notion, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform. They should be able to write and refine prompts and Claude skills, compare alternative approaches, test output quality, and improve workflows until they produce reliable, professional results.
  
  
This is not a data science, machine learning, or purely technical development role. It is a hands-on advisory and delivery role focused on improving the speed, quality, and consistency of consulting work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Build AI-Enabled Delivery Workflows**

* Create and maintain reusable AI workflows for research, document review, file analysis, synthesis, writing, and presentation development
* Write and refine Claude skills, system instructions, prompts, custom assistants, and workflow templates
* Build structured processes for analyzing interview notes, client files, data rooms, requirements, prior deliverables, and other source materials
* Define clear inputs, outputs, validation steps, and human-review checkpoints
* Convert repeatable consulting activities into documented workflows
* Maintain and improve existing workflows as tools and models change

**Test and Refine AI Outputs**

* Compare AI tools, models, prompts, context approaches, and workflow designs
* Conduct structured A/B testing using defined evaluation criteria
* Evaluate outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, insight, and usability
* Document test results, version history, lessons learned, and recommended approaches
* Identify gaps, errors, unsupported conclusions, and weak analysis in AI-generated content
* Continue refining solutions rather than accepting the first usable output

**Perform Analysis and Develop Deliverables**

* Review and synthesize information from documents, spreadsheets, presentations, interview notes, and other source materials
* Identify key themes, risks, findings, inconsistencies, and implications
* Support development of clear conclusions and practical recommendations
* Create well-structured written deliverables and professional PowerPoint presentations
* Support Excel-based analysis, cost estimates, and financial models
* Validate AI-generated content against source materials before it is used
* Apply judgment to determine whether an output is accurate, clear, and decision-useful

**Build Knowledge and Content Systems**

* Organize prompts, skills, workflows, templates, evaluations, and guidance in Notion or similar platforms
* Develop structured data and knowledge systems that organize source materials, findings, and reusable content
* Support content organization across Notion, SharePoint, Teams, and Microsoft 365
* Maintain clear documentation, version history, and usage instructions
* Create quick-reference guides and supporting materials that allow others to reuse workflows

**Support Enterprise Tools and Automation**

* Explore how AI workflows can operate with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio, and related tools
* Build or support simple low-code automations and multi-tool workflows
* Use scripting, APIs, MCP, structured data, or AI-assisted coding where appropriate
* Help design processes for moving, reviewing, analyzing, and storing files
* Support approved content access, permissions, confidentiality, and governance requirements
* Coordinate with technical teams when advanced development or integration support is needed

**Support Consulting Engagements**

* Work with U.S.-based and India-based team members to understand delivery needs
* Support IT Due Diligence, IT Assessment, integration, ERP advisory, and related engagements
* Review and synthesize client data and technical materials
* Assist in building findings, recommendations, presentations, cost estimates, and other deliverables
* Independently manage defined workstreams and deliverables
* Collaborate effectively across time zones and communicate progress clearly
* Build working knowledge across areas such as enterprise applications, data and reporting, AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and IT operations
* Develop deeper knowledge in one or more technology domains over time

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
* Strong hands-on experience using generative AI tools for professional work
* Demonstrated experience building and refining prompts, reusable assistants, workflows, or automations
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills
* Ability to review multiple sources and synthesize information into clear findings
* Strong written communication and PowerPoint development skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the ability to support analysis and modeling
* Ability to execute against clear direction and independently work through open-ended problems
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Strong organizational, documentation, and task-management skills
* Ability to work collaboratively across time zones
* Ability to identify unsupported conclusions or quality issues in AI-generated content

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced experience with Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Notion, or similar tools
* Experience creating Claude skills, custom GPTs, project instructions, reusable agents, or prompt libraries
* Experience conducting structured A/B testing or comparing alternative workflow approaches
* Experience with SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Copilot Studio
* Familiarity with APIs, MCP, scripting, structured data, schema design, low-code development, or AI-assisted coding
* Experience with document analysis, enterprise search, or knowledge management
* Familiarity with consulting, professional services, technology advisory, ERP, due diligence, integration, or business transformation
* Working knowledge in one or more IT domains, such as enterprise systems, data and reporting, AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or IT operations
* Experience supporting U.S.-based or global teams

**What Success Looks Like**
Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate will:
  
  

* Understand the practice’s core workflows, deliverables, and quality standards
* Build and document reusable AI-enabled workflows
* Create and refine prompts, Claude skills, or reusable AI instructions
* Conduct structured tests comparing prompts, tools, models, or workflow approaches
* Produce accurate written analysis, Excel-based support, and professional PowerPoint output
* Organize prompts, workflows, evaluation results, and guidance in Notion or another knowledge platform
* Support an initial use case involving SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or Power Platform
* Contribute effectively to consulting workstreams and client deliverables
* Incorporate feedback from senior team members and continuously improve the solution
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in efficiency, consistency, or output quality

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate:
  
  

* Uses AI tools regularly and enjoys experimenting with them
* Likes adjusting prompts, instructions, and workflows until the output improves
* Can perform the underlying analysis rather than relying entirely on AI
* Understands the difference between polished language and meaningful insight
* Produces organized, accurate, and professional work
* Is comfortable working across documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and knowledge systems
* Enjoys building reusable solutions rather than repeating manual tasks
* Can accept feedback, improve quickly, and operate with limited direction
* Is reliable, detail-oriented, and able to support a global consulting team
* Is curious about tools, models, integrations, and emerging capabilities

**What This Role Is Not**
This role is not primarily focused on:
  
  

* Building machine-learning models
* Conducting academic AI research
* Traditional software engineering
* Creating AI strategy presentations without hands-on execution
* Writing prompts without evaluating the underlying analysis
* Producing PowerPoint slides without understanding the content
* Testing new tools without turning them into repeatable processes

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
The Staff Software Development Engineer role within Clearwater’s Agentic Client Interactions & Orchestration (ACIO) is a senior technical leadership position focused on architecting, designing, and delivering large-scale distributed systems that power critical financial reporting and analytics. This role requires deep expertise in scalable system design, agentic architecture, cloud-native platforms, and high-performance data processing.
  
  
You will play a key role in shaping the technical direction, ensuring architectural excellence, and enabling teams to build robust, maintainable systems that support Clearwater’s commitment to industry-leading financial reporting solutions. Senior engineers at this level are expected to think strategically, lead through influence, and drive innovations that scale across products and teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Design Leadership**

* Own the end-to-end architecture of Clearwater ACIO systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance in large-scale financial data processing.
* Define, document, and communicate architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for distributed systems.
* Evaluate and implement design patterns for fault tolerance, high availability, and horizontal scalability.
* Collaborate with product managers, data architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into system-level designs and technical roadmaps.
* Conduct architectural reviews and provide engineering guidance to ensure alignment with strategic technology vision.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery**

* Lead the technical strategy, operational excellence, and professional delivery across multiple domains in Clearwater.
* Drive improvements in system observability, maintainability, and deployment automation.
* Ensure designs and implementations meet security, compliance, and performance benchmarks.
* Oversee execution of multi-team, multi-service projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery at scale.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers in architecture thinking, technical design, and distributed systems development.
* Build strong relationships with teams across divisions to facilitate cross-system integration and shared technology improvements.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging architectures, and cloud technologies.
* Identify opportunities for re-architecting or optimizing existing systems to improve throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency.
* Foster a culture of innovation, scalability, and engineering excellence across FO Reporting and broader Clearwater teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Proven architecture and design expertise in large-scale distributed systems, preferably in financial or analytics platforms.
* Exceptional leadership skills and ability to lead through influence as a technical architect or senior tech lead.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and data streaming platforms (Kafka, AWS Kinesis, etc.).
* Hands-on experience with public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including scaling, cost optimization, and multi-region deployments.
* Proficiency in one or more modern languages (Java, Python, Go, or similar) with deep understanding of concurrency, memory management, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of distributed data storage, database scaling, and query optimization techniques.
* Worked on agentic conversational UX design and architecture.
* Developed and deployed systems with complex SLAs in production environments serving high-volume traffic/data.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to clearly convey architectural decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Commitment to continuous technical learning, improvement, and community knowledge sharing.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of professional software development experience; 5+ years acting in an architecture or principal engineering capacity.
* Track record of designing and implementing enterprise-grade distributed systems and owning them through full lifecycle (design → build → deploy → maintain).

title: Senior Principal, AI Delivery & Governance Lead
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
We are seeking a Senior Principal, AI Delivery & Governance Lead to drive the delivery and governance of the SMBS AI programme. SMBS is building a live AI ecosystem — agents in production, workflows redesigned, outcomes measured. This is not a strategy exercise — we are building the next generation of our operational engine. This role does not build AI solutions directly — it ensures the conditions are in place for the build team to deliver effectively and for what is built to land with real operational impact.
  
  
This role owns the AI backlog and solution delivery assurance — governing what gets built and when, translating use case inputs from Ops Intelligence Analysts and Delivery Excellence teams into structured backlog items, and ensuring the build team works on the highest-impact opportunities. This is transformational delivery: systematically replacing manual, judgement-heavy processes with intelligent, scalable AI solutions. With typically 7+ years of experience in programme delivery or technology transformation, this is a role for someone experienced in moving from proof of concept to operational reality.
  
  
SMBS AI does not operate in isolation. This role coordinates across the full SimCorp AI ecosystem — Product AI, Platform and Infrastructure, AI Search and Knowledge, and Compliance and Legal — aligning standards, resolving dependencies, and leveraging what is being built across SimCorp. It also shapes how SMBS transitions into this next stage, influencing the AI guidelines, governance principles, and ways of working across DMS, IOS, and IAS.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
In your daily work, you will:
  
  

* Manage the interface between the SMBS AI team and all other SimCorp AI teams, ensuring alignment on standards, dependencies, and shared roadmaps.
* Maintain the Integration Dependency Register as the single source of truth for cross-team dependencies, blockers, and agreements.
* Represent the SMBS AI team in cross-company AI governance forums and steering committees.
* Facilitate the resolution of scope boundaries and overlapping use cases with the Product AI team.
* Own the AI use case backlog, ensuring use cases are consistently structured, scored, and prioritized using the established evaluation framework.
* Receive and structure use case inputs from service unit Ops Intelligence Analysts and Delivery Excellence teams.
* Coordinate sprint planning and release sequencing with the build team.
* Manage the intake of change requests for agents in production and prioritize them against new development.
* Prepare board and executive materials related to the AI initiative, including progress reporting, investment tracking, and impact measurement.
* Manage stakeholder expectations across service units, ensuring transparency on timelines, priorities, and delivery capacity.
* Drive the compliance and legal whitelisting process for AI tools and models, ensuring tooling is approved before the build team requires it.
* Ensure the AI initiative remains anchored in the service scalability strategy and does not drift into technology-for-technology’s-sake initiatives.

**What We Value**

* 7+ years of experience in program management, operational transformation, or service delivery leadership within financial services.
* Deep understanding of investment operations across Data Management, Investment Operations, and Investment Accounting.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across multiple teams with competing priorities and without direct authority.
* Experience managing structured backlogs and prioritization frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation capabilities at senior and executive levels.
* You can hold a substantive conversation with AI engineers about agent design, model selection, and deployment trade-offs and translate those conversations into decisions and priorities that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
* You are a clear and confident communicator who can represent complex AI initiatives to executive audiences.
* You thrive in ambiguous environments and bring structure and clarity where others see complexity.
* You have good English skills and are comfortable working in an international, cross-functional environment.
* You have effective collaboration skills and a bias for organizational alignment over individual delivery.

You operate as a senior individual contributor who influences outcomes through structure, clarity, and credibility — not through hierarchy. Your value is in making the system around you work better, not in being the one who executes.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy — We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation — Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team, or the organization.
* Self-Direction — High degree of self-organization. Each team member has a high degree of freedom to plan, organize, and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance — We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment — We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**Who We Are**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.
  
  
We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Here at OCI we’re building the world’s largest AI clusters and we’re the fastest at bringing them to the market. The AI Infrastructure organization at OCI is leading this effort by creating a GPU focused cloud with the latest hardware providing the best performance, efficiency, reliability, and scalability. This is your chance to be part of the AI revolution by creating systems that allow customers to scale from tens to thousands of GPUs without compromising performance. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and make a significant impact on our organization's success.
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled distributed systems engineer to scale and optimize AI infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane that provide computing resources to customer AI workloads. You will provide technical leadership to the team and bring clarity to ambiguous problems and come up with innovative solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance our AI infrastructure to deliver exceptional customer experience and peak performance
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop solutions to scale and optimize AI compute infrastructure components like GPU control plane and GPU data plane with the goal to optimize customer experience and customer workload performance on our AI infrastructure.
* Develop “best-in-class” AI compute infrastructure for our customers by ensuring that the services and the components are well-defined and modularized, secure, reliable, diagnosable, actively monitored, compliant and reusable.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, operations, and product management, to understand their requirements and design innovative orchestration solutions.
* Mentor junior developers and drive modern software engineering practices like leveraging data/telemetry to make decisions, well-defined interfaces across components, design reviews, coding standards, code reviews, and comprehensive coverage from unit test, integration test and active production monitoring.
* Develop benchmark metrics and automation to drive and track performance and reliability across customer workload and lower infrastructure stack. ­

**Qualifications & Skills**

* BS (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in software development with programming languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, Go, Rust.
* 3 years of experience designing and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and services.
* 1 year of experience providing technical leadership and clarity to cross-functional teams and projects while collaborating across stake holders.
* Systematic problem-solving approach, strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and drive.
* Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in managing cloud infrastructure with hundreds of thousands of servers.
* Experience in containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience in scheduling high-performance workloads on Kubernetes or Slurm.

We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Senior AI Technologist
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
The AI Technologist – Autonomous Networks designs, builds and industrialises AI/ML, GenAI and agentic AI solutions for network managed services and network intelligence. The role applies advanced AI to large-scale telecom and IT data, develops production-grade models, pipelines and digital-engineer agents, and collaborates with AI Domain Solution Leaders, architects and product teams to deliver scalable, secure and trustworthy solutions for Ericsson and its customers.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Identify and lead AI/ML, GenAI and agentic AI opportunities across Ericsson businesses and strategic customers.
* Define data science problem statements, model validation strategies and measurable business outcomes.
* Design data architectures, data flows, feature engineering approaches and ML, deep learning, GenAI and agentic AI architectures.
* Develop and deploy predictive, anomaly detection, recommendation, root-cause and other AI/ML solutions using large-scale 4G/5G/5G-Advanced, IoT and OSS/BSS data.
* Design and implement GenAI solutions using LLMs, RAG, tool calling, agent orchestration and autonomous or assisted digital-engineer workflows for network operations.
* Lead PoCs and MVPs from problem definition and data exploration through production deployment and monitoring.
* Industrialise AI solutions with product teams through production-grade code, APIs, workflows and documentation.
* Build scalable data pipelines and storage/retrieval solutions for structured and unstructured data, including KPIs, logs, text and images.
* Own the MLOps lifecycle covering training, deployment, serving, monitoring, evaluation and model lifecycle management.
* Integrate AI models with network automation applications and Ericsson platforms through standard APIs and automation interfaces.
* Apply trustworthy-AI principles, guardrails, explainability, security and human-in-the-loop controls for safe deployment in live networks.

**The skills you bring:**

* Bachelor's/Master's/Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of industry experience, including 5+ years of production-level AI/ML experience, with hands-on GenAI and/or agentic AI development.
* Proven experience taking AI/ML and GenAI solutions from problem definition to production, including LLM assistants, RAG and AI agents.
* Strong programming and software-engineering skills with modern AI/ML and deep-learning frameworks, APIs, version control, testing and CI/CD.
* Strong knowledge of MLOps, SDLC, observability, security, model evaluation, configuration management and production readiness.
* Practical experience with the GCP AI ecosystem, including Vertex AI, Gemini, ADK, Agent Engine/Runtime, Model Garden, vector search, BigQuery, Spanner, Knowledge Catalog and Agent Gateway.
* Strong understanding of agentic AI architecture, including orchestration, agent harnesses, A2A, MCP, memory management, context engineering and token/cost optimisation.
* Hands-on expertise in data engineering, pipelines, big-data processing, storage, indexing, partitioning and retrieval.
* Telecommunications or IoT experience, particularly 4G/5G, OSS/BSS, network automation or network intelligence, is highly desirable.
* Ability to translate complex business and network challenges into practical AI solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong customer and value orientation, collaboration, creativity, ownership and ability to drive complex initiatives to completion.
* Experience with AI/ML communities, technical publications, white papers, conferences or patents is a plus.

Good expertise and skills using Claude/Codex or equivalent AI tools to do research, planning, software development and testing.

English proficiency at Advanced level.
  
  
Good presentation and demonstration skills

Lead Discovery and/or Advisory projects, understand customer’s needs, collect inputs and pain points from the customer and create working SW prototypes within limited time to demonstrate feasibility & value.
  
  
Collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and QA to further develop prototypes into scalable production systems.
  
  
Contribute to the development of GlobalLogic’s healthcare-focused AI accelerators and reusable components.
  
  
Present technical solutions to clients, both business and technical audiences.
  
  
Ensure adherence to privacy, security, and compliance standards for data and AI usage.
  
  
Author clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
  
  
What we offer

We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

description: Lead AI Engineer Department: Product & Engineering (AI) Location: Noida, India · Onsite Scope: Global About Doceree Doceree as the first global network of physician-only platforms for programmatic messaging, Doceree is transforming the digital communication landscape in the global healthcare industry. Doceree provides the most comprehensive solution to Healthcare and Lifesciences advertisers to reach the target audience in the most effective and efficient way through programmatic digital advertising. Our Core Belief Technology can connect the fragmented healthcare ecosystem to deliver information when it is most needed to improve patients' outcomes. We are expanding our footprints across the globe and enhancing our services, offering, and developing new products and solutions to address the unmet needs of industry. Doceree is operating in 25+ countries currently with offices in NY, India and London. Website http://www.doceree.com/ Social media link https://www.linkedin.com/company/doceree/ About The Job Position Title: Lead AI Engineer Department: Product & Engineering (AI) Job Scope: Global Location: Noida, Work Setting: Onsite Purpose of the Job Doceree is building the first proactive intelligence layer for pharma brand teams — an agentic AI system that turns clinical intent signals, campaign data, and market context into a daily brief that drives a decision in under five minutes. We are hiring AI Engineers to build the systems behind that surface. You will design and ship production AI systems — LLM-powered pipelines, agentic workflows, retrieval over heterogeneous healthcare data, evaluation harnesses, and the orchestration layer that sits between our signal foundation and the brand manager's morning brief. You'll work closely with data scientists, product, and platform engineering to take prototypes from a notebook to something a brand team relies on every day. You'll thrive here if you enjoy living at the seam between LLMs, traditional ML, and well-engineered backend systems — and if you care about making AI useful, reliable, and measurably better in a regulated, real-world domain. Key Responsibilities Own the end-to-end technical vision and execution of AI-powered capabilities for specific products, starting with the Daily Command platform, from early prototypes to production systems. Design, build, and ship production-grade LLM and agentic AI systems powering anomaly detection, contextual synthesis, next-best-action recommendations, and one-click activation. Build and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems leveraging Doceree’s clinical intent signals, campaign data, market intelligence, and partner datasets. Develop agentic workflows and orchestration patterns including tool use, planning, structured outputs, guardrails, and multi-step reasoning. Establish robust evaluation, monitoring, and observability frameworks to measure quality, reliability, business impact, and model performance over time. Make pragmatic decisions around model selection, architecture, vendor partnerships, and build-vs-buy tradeoffs across commercial and open-source AI ecosystems. Partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to translate ambiguous business opportunities into scalable AI solutions. Productionize ML and AI capabilities through APIs, services, and reusable platform components that can be consumed across products. Own deployment, reliability, performance, and cost management of AI systems running on AWS. Establish best practices for AI engineering, including prompt management, testing, experimentation, security, privacy, and compliance. Serve as the technical leader for AI initiatives, mentoring future team members and helping shape the long-term AI roadmap for the organization. Stay current with advances in LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, and AI infrastructure, and evaluate where emerging technologies can create competitive advantage. Qualifications Requirement: Experience, Skills & Education B. Tech / M.Tech / Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline. 6–12 years of software engineering and AI/ML experience, including at least 2–3 years building production LLM, generative AI, or agent-based applications. Strong hands-on programming experience in Python and modern software engineering practices, including system design, testing, API development, and cloud-native architectures. Proven experience building and deploying AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, agents, recommendation systems, search, or related technologies. Experience with modern AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent custom implementations. Experience designing evaluation frameworks and monitoring production AI systems beyond simple prompt experimentation. Strong understanding of classical ML/DL techniques and libraries (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, SpaCy, NumPy, Pandas) and when not to use an LLM. Experience building and operating services on AWS using technologies such as ECS/EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, Bedrock, or equivalent cloud platforms. Ability to operate independently, make architectural decisions, and drive projects from concept through production with minimal oversight. Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience building multi-agent or workflow-oriented AI systems. Experience with vector databases, retrieval systems, embeddings, and search infrastructure. Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps tooling, model monitoring, and experimentation platforms. Experr other data-rich regulated environments. Experience with claims, Rx, EHR-derived signals, HCP identity, campaign telemetry, attribution, and awareness of HIPAA / GDPR / DPDP considerations is a big plus. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), event/streaming systems (Kafka, Kinesis), and big-data tooling (Spark, Aerospike, DuckDB). Contributions to open-source projects, technical publications, patents, or a portfolio of shipped AI products. Why Explore a Career at Doceree Be a part of the revolution in healthcare marketing. Innovate with us to unite and transform the Healthcare Providers (HCPs) ecosystem for improved patient outcomes. Doceree has been recognized and certified two times in a row – Best Places to Work NJ 2023, Great Place to Work 2023. You'll be joining the team building Doceree's next-generation agentic AI surface — the system that turns fragmented healthcare signals into the one decision a brand manager makes before standup. The problems are real, the data is rich, and the gap between "demo" and "decision that moved NBRx" is exactly where this role lives. If you are passionate about applied AI, healthcare, and shipping systems that change how decisions actually get made, we'd love to talk. **The Opportunity**
EY GDS Cybersecurity is seeking an experienced IAM AI Manager to help clients modernize their Identity and Access Management landscape through AI-led transformation. This role focuses on identifying where AI can improve IAM operations, governance, access risk management, privileged access, and non-human identity controls across enterprise environments.

The role requires strong IAM domain understanding, consulting leadership, and the ability to shape solution approaches that improve identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, privileged access, compliance posture, and emerging areas such as agent, workload, and service identities.

**Technical architecture & design**

**LLM, Reasoning & Knowledge Engineering**

* Design AI-led IAM use cases using LLMs, RAG, agents, copilots, orchestration frameworks, and responsible AI guardrails.

**IAM integration automation leadership**

* Lead client workshops, discovery, solution shaping, estimation, roadmap definition, and executive-level IAM-AI storytelling.
* Design AI-enabled governance capabilities across SailPoint, Saviynt, access reviews, lifecycle management, provisioning, SOD, and compliance reporting.

* Develop client-ready insights and dashboards using identity data, analytics, automation, and visualization tools.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in IAM, cybersecurity consulting, AI architecture, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics.
* Strong understanding of IAM domains including IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, AD/Entra ID, NHI, lifecycle management, governance, provisioning, access reviews, and risk scoring.
* Working knowledge of AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, AI agents, copilots, orchestration, embeddings, and cloud AI services.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation scripts, data pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns.
* Good understanding of IAM protocols and controls including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, authorization, and certificate/key management.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and executive storytelling skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Big 4, GDS, global delivery, or consulting-led environments.
* Ability to create PoC/MVP plans, architecture views, roadmap slides, executive summaries, and client demos.
* Exposure to IAM modernization, NHI governance, privileged access transformation, AI adoption, and responsible AI controls.
* Relevant working knowledge or certifications across CISSP, CISM, Azure AI, Google ML, Saviynt, SailPoint, CyberArk, or cloud security are preferred.

**Certifications, Compliance & Assurance**

* Ensure IAM-AI solutions are secure, auditable, explainable, and aligned with client risk, compliance, and assurance expectations.

title: Senior AI Creative Technologist
description:
**Work Mode:**

Remote

**Engagement Duration:**

3 months (Open-Ended).

We’re building ESGA’s AI creative production engine, and we want an expert to help us build it from scratch.

This is a short-term project with real ownership. You’ll test the latest AI tools, design the workflows our team will use every day, set up how production runs end to end, and map out how we scale to high-quality creative output for global brands.

The systems you build will become the foundation of how ESGA creates. If you love figuring out how AI production should work, not just using it, we’d love to talk.

**What You Will Do**

* **Map Production Capabilities:**

  Define the production capabilities required across static imagery, design assets, motion, video, and campaign content.
* **Design the Process**

  : Determine the right combination of AI tools, models, and production methods for each capability, assessed on quality, consistency, cost, and turnaround.
* **Build Systems:**

  Design end-to-end workflows, SOPs, experimentation frameworks, and quality-control processes that improve production quality, consistency, and efficiency.
* **Define Requirements:**

  Specify the talent, skills, tools, infrastructure, resources, and operating model required at each production stage.
* **Design creator evaluation**

  : Design pilot projects, practical assessments, and scoring rubrics to evaluate and shortlist AI creators and production staff.
* **Build the Roadmap:**

  Create a phased implementation plan outlining build priorities, hiring sequence, timelines, milestones, and readiness checklists.
* **Develop Client Documentation**

  : Design and audit client-facing AI production documents, including AI usage logs, tool and model disclosures, creator inputs, subscription and licensing details.

**Experience & Background**

* 5–10 years of experience across creative technology, generative AI production, creative operations, or AI-enabled content systems.
* Hands-on proficiency with node-based and generative creative tools such as Higgsfield, ComfyUI, Flora, and similar platforms.
* A track record of building repeatable AI workflows and production systems, not just generating assets.
* Strong understanding of AI image and video generation: capabilities, limitations, output quality, licensing considerations, and practical production applications.
* Experience evaluating emerging tools and translating experimentation into production-ready workflows.
* A systems-thinking mindset, with the ability to connect creative requirements with the right tools, talent, and technology.
* Ability to independently lead experimentation and develop a practical implementation roadmap.

**Who This Role Is Not For**

* AI artists focused exclusively on generating individual images or videos without building repeatable workflows.
* Candidates with only theoretical knowledge of AI tools and no hands-on experimentation experience.
* Software engineers or model developers without experience in creative production.

**About ESGA:**

We build and manage capability centers for brands and agencies. If you're looking for a team that's all about collaboration, growth, inclusivity, and good vibes, then you've found your perfect match.
